auditor_maya: Quick ask for SOC2 fieldwork — we need evidence for the RBAC update and KMS usage during the maintenance on 2024-12-18. Specifically: the approver trail, infra diff (Terraform/helm), k8s audit lines for the RoleBinding/ClusterRoleBinding change, CloudTrail KMS events (GenerateDataKey/Decrypt), and key rotation policy snapshot. Please bundle and map files to SOC2 CC6/CC7.

elliot_sre: assigning. I will collect: GH PR export, terraform plan/apply logs, helm upgrade diff, k8s audit extract for namespace inference-prod, CloudTrail slice for KMS, and the key policy PDF. Any format requirements?

auditor_maya: machine-readable preferred (jsonl). Include a README that has one-line mapping per file to SOC2 controls and note any redactions. Also include a timeline.txt that correlates PR->CI->TF apply->k8s patch->KMS event.

nina_sec: context: change added serviceAccount inference-cache-writer to ClusterRoleBinding inference-deployers and was part of CVE remediation. The CI job was ci/deploy/inference:release-20241218 and deploy_id=20241218-rc3. We rotated alias/redwood-inf-cache as a precaution at 2024-12-18T04:12:00Z.

ops_john: I merged PR #4120 (sha: ab12f4) and kicked the Terraform apply: tf-apply-20241218-55. Okta approval event id: okta_evt_7789 — I'll export the Okta audit event.

elliot_sre: plan: produce evidence_manifest.jsonl, README.md, timeline.txt, pr-export.jsonl, terraform-apply.log, helm-diff.patch, k8s-audit.jsonl, cloudtrail-kms.jsonl, keypolicy.pdf, checksums.sha256. I'll compute sha256 for each file.

auditor_maya: For KMS we need: key id/arn, list of GenerateDataKey and Decrypt events, and the identity that called them (assumed role mapping). If you can annotate one event showing encryptionContext.deploy_id that ties to deploy_id, that will satisfy correlation.

nina_sec: KMS key ARN: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/ca9f-1b2c-3d4e. Last automated rotation 2023-12-01; there was a manual rewrap for the cache on 2024-12-18. CloudHSM was used for root key.

elliot_sre: sample CloudTrail snippet I'll include (sanitized): {"eventTime":"2024-12-18T04:13:02Z","eventName":"GenerateDataKey","userIdentity":{"type":"AssumedRole","arn":"arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/inference-runtime-role/runner"},"resources":["arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/ca9f-1b2c-3d4e"],"requestParameters":{"encryptionContext":{"deploy_id":"20241218-rc3","pr_sha":"ab12f4"}}}

ops_john: k8s audit will show the patch to ClusterRoleBinding by user john_ops (my account). I'll export the exact jsonl. Example sanitized line: {"stageTimestamp":"2024-12-18T04:11:47Z","verb":"patch","user":{"username":"ops_john","uid":"U-921"},"objectRef":{"resource":"clusterrolebindings","name":"inference-deployers"},"requestObject":{"changes":"+subjects:[{kind:ServiceAccount,name:inference-cache-writer}]"}}

nina_sec: note emergency access earlier in window: there was a short-lived escalation to fix a failed canary. PD incident IN-912 logged — include PagerDuty approval export.

elliot_sre: will add a small narrative in README.md describing the PD escalation and link to the approval artifact. Also will include sha256 checksums and timeline.txt mapping PR#4120 -> ci/deploy/inference:release-20241218 -> tf-apply-20241218-55 -> kube patch -> KMS GenerateDataKey.

auditor_maya: two extra asks: 1) include a SHA256 hash for each export file in checksums.sha256 2) redact any token/ciphertext blobs but annotate the redaction locations in README.

telliot_sre: acknowledged. I will redact ciphertext blobs and mark them in README. ETA for bundle: 30 mins. Will upload to s3://redwood-audit-drop/soc2/2024-12-18/1777771234_bundle.zip and DM a presigned link.

deploy-bot: pipeline ci/deploy/inference:release-20241218 completed; status: success; artifact: sha256:4f3c2a...; deploy_id: 20241218-rc3.

ops_john: uploaded bundle and checksums to the audit bucket, presigned link sent in DM. Files included and checksums computed.

auditor_maya: received. We'll review and raise follow-ups if deeper traces are needed. Thank you for the clear mapping to CC6/CC7.

nina_sec: post-audit action created: SEC-701 — propagate deploy_id into KMS encryptionContext automatically and include persistent deploy identifier in CI logs.

elliot_sre: filing a runbook update for key rotation notes and HSM binding. Closing this thread unless auditor asks for expanded raw logs.
